title: When Should Diffusion Language Models Reconsider Their Commitments?
abstract: arXiv:2611.11551v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) are well known for fast text generation via parallel decoding. However, independent parallel sampling can commit to inconsistent predictions, and less is known about how to selectively revise these early token commitments. In this work, we introduce $\underline{\mathrm{P}}$lanned $\underline{\mathrm{U}}$nmasking-and-$\underline{\mathrm{R}}$evision Joint $\underline{\mathrm{L}}$earning (PURL) for MDMs, a training-based framework that seamlessly unifies parallel generation with selective token revision. We derive a normalized joint transition whose likelihood factorizes into edit selection, unmask selection, and token prediction. These components are trained jointly on partially masked sequences constructed according to the model's own unmasking policy. During inference, all three decisions are supported by a single shared forward pass, enabling the model to decode masked tokens and revise noisy tok

translated_title: 扩散语言模型何时应重新考虑其承诺？
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型以通过并行解码实现快速文本生成而闻名。然而，相互独立的并行采样可能会在早期就“承诺”不一致的预测结果，而关于如何有选择地修正这些早期的词元承诺，目前所知甚少。在这项工作中，我们为掩码扩散模型提出了计划式取消掩码与修正联合学习（Planned Unmasking-and-Revision Joint Learning, PURL），这是一个基于训练的框架，无缝地将并行生成与选择性词元修正统一起来。我们推导出了一个归一化的联合转移，其似然可以分解为编辑选择、取消掩码选择和词元预测三个部分。这些组件在根据模型自身取消掩码策略构建的部分掩码序列上进行联合训练。在推理阶段，所有三个决策均由一次共享的前向传播所支持，使模型能够解码被掩码的词元并修正带有噪声的词元。
tldr: 该论文提出PURL框架，通过联合学习编辑选择、取消掩码选择和词元预测三个决策，使掩码扩散模型能够在并行快速生成的同时有选择地修正早期不一致的词元承诺，且推理时三个决策仅需一次共享前向传播即可完成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PURL, a training-based framework that jointly learns edit selection, unmask selection, and token prediction—supported by a single shared forward pass during inference—enabling masked diffusion models to unify fast parallel generation with selective revision of early inconsistent token commitments.
